_comment: RUN QUEUE P6 (docs/RUNQUEUE_pdfix_reask.md) - THE PAYOFF LEG, 6 h.
WHAT 'BEST' RESOLVED TO, AND WHY IT IS JUST v3 EXTENDED.  The queue defines P6 as 'P1
winner + best of P2/P3'.  Both of those axes came back empty, so the honest composition
is the P1 winner alone at double the duration:
- P1 winner = _ft63_pdfix_v3.json (carry_invariant_innov_corroborate).  Chord
informational lifetime 12.0 -> 55.3 ep, flags 18559 -> 307 of which 209 (68 %) carry
raw_stepped=1, mature steps 0.953/0.789/0.485, total_IF and clock QC neutral-to-better.
- P2 contributes NOTHING: qz0 flattens the DD walk (0.168/0.096/0.030, SF k=32 1.51) but
FAILS the card's stated clock-QC rule (clk_std 4.86 -> 5.29, total_IF worst_med
+16.4 %).  q_z=1e-4 stands, on a NEW mechanism (q_z decides whether the iono
mismodelling lands in the carried DDs or in the sat clocks / code biases).
- P3 contributes NOTHING: the subtractive iono ladder is a complete null that reproduces
(layer2 off / mech-B off / sigma_rep 5 -> 50 all within noise).
So the ONLY delta over _ft63_pdfix_v3.json is 10800 -> 21600 s.  That is deliberate: P6 is
a DURATION question, not a posture question, and adding an unvalidated knob would confound
the two things it exists to answer.
THE TWO QUESTIONS (queue P6 verbatim):
(a) DOES total_IF CONVERGE PAST THE CONTROL?  The 3 h pdfix_on leg moved total_IF hr2
+12.4 % vs the pre-fix control, but with the opposite SHAPE: it starts 28 % WIDER at
hr0 (13.543 vs 10.600) and converges HARDER (ratio 0.653 vs 0.755), i.e. ignition now
re-earns information instead of freezing whatever it grabbed first.  Whether that
crossover happens is not a 3 h question.  Grade the hr0->hr5 trajectory, not one bin.
(b) THE FIRST HONEST med|frac| / circR TREND ON MATURED CHORDS.  Every previous read of
'is there integer information at this cadence and geometry' was taken on the corrupt
substrate, where 85.24 % of carried row-epochs folded inertly and chord lifetime was
12 epochs.  At 55.3 ep lifetime and a working fold, a 6 h leg is the first run where
a chord can plausibly mature far enough for the question to have an answer.
med|frac| has sat at 0.24-0.25 (uniform = zero integer information) in EVERY arm to
date, including pdfix_on.  Grade whether it MOVES, and read it per age bin, not
pooled - a pooled median over a population still dominated by young chords cannot
show a mature-chord effect even if one exists.
GRADE: scripts/grade_dd_spillway.py (steps by age + SF + cross-band),
scripts/grade_ddfrac_perhour.py (med|frac| and circR BY HOUR and BY AGE BIN),
scripts/chain_stability.py (total_IF per hour + clk), scripts/parse_carry_psd.py (the PD
gate must hold for 720 epochs, not 360 - INC-1c repairs and INC-2a rebirths are still
field-UNEXERCISED, so a first firing here is a finding either way).
COST: ~22 min at the 3 h leg's 2481 ms/epoch (720 epochs).
